adversarial_review.check: Different local Gibbs matrices are kept as separate union-level records; no cross-union sum is interpreted as a single state seminorm.
All registered source supports are retained, and every selected union is labelled by the source supports it touches; no unlisted translation is claimed.
E is fixed independently of oscillator dimension and volume, with rank and mass recorded for each union.
Tail spreads use only d={5,6,8}; no spatial or cutoff limit is asserted.
Signed and absolute pair aggregates remain separate for every union and window.
Forward and reversed term orders are rebuilt and compared at every selected union.
All four weighted legs use the projected Gibbs square root separately; no commutation through the operator is assumed.
The independent lane reconstructs oscillator, local terms, spectral projectors and union rows without importing the primary module.
Spatial finite-window behavior is only a topology diagnostic; global KMS transfer, common core, thermodynamic history, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
R360 checks exact finite grid/count arithmetic and scope only; matrix spectra and QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite spatial/source spectral-window stress only. It is not a global state theorem, cutoff-removal theorem or QFT/Clay result.

lean_crosscheck.role: R360 checks exact finite spatial/source/window counts and finite-only scope; local spectral projectors, norms and QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

named_proxy.aggregation: union-level rows are never normalized or summed across different U; tail spread is evaluated per (volume,beta,E,U) key
named_proxy.coefficient: signed and absolute window seminorms, conditional normalization, Gibbs mass/rank and source-touching labels are reported per union
named_proxy.core: finite oscillator matrix proxy on each source-touching union U with |U|<=3
named_proxy.state: rho_U=exp(-beta H_U)/Tr(exp(-beta H_U)) for the induced local Hamiltonian on each union separately
named_proxy.window: P_E is the spectral projector of H_U-min(spec H_U) onto energies <= E, with E fixed independently of oscillator dimension and volume
